analysis.r4_reflection_note: R4 discovers DOUBLE BLUR (glass:2+gaussian:1) as a structural advance over the single-blur paradigm used in R0-R3. sim PSNR=37.30dB (+0.72dB vs single glass:2=36.58). Both orderings improve, confirming the double-blur effect. gm_ratio=0.532 is unusually strong for single blur, suggesting two-stage blur. ALL previous R0-R3 rounds tested only single blur types. Double-blur training may close the 12dB gap between sim PSNR (37.30) and training PSNR (24.33 for single-blur).

r4_signal_sources.double_blur_discovery: gm_ratio=0.532 unusually strong for single blur → tested glass:2+gaussian:1 → PSNR=37.30dB (best ever). Signal sources: [gm_ratio=0.532 + GT training PSNR=24.33 for single-blur + all single-blur types tested and trained with low PSNR]

analysis.per_step_note: 2-step double blur (glass:2→gaussian:1). Both steps UNCERTAIN (PSNR 37.30 in 30-40 range). This is the first multi-step degradation hypothesis for this challenge — all R0-R3 were single-step. NO_JPEG (confirmed by 5 R4 tests), NO_NOISE (confirmed by 2 R4 tests), NO_GLOBAL. Architecture: DualBranch recommended (2-step UNCERTAIN).
